note: Where each district of the Live Map's isometric cyber city sits, in pixels of the 2400x1440 scene (origin top left), measured on the painted city plate (work/city/idle-2400.png). The main districts and the AI core are painted into the plate; their `sprite` is the lit crop (lit-<id>) the renderer fades in over the same rect while the district works. Since 25/11/2026 the small parts (memory, skills, security, user-desk, monitoring) are painted in too, with their own lit crops; context-fill is drawn over the monitoring reservoir by %. rect: [x, y, w, h], the district's area and click area; tier: 1 main, 2 secondary, 3 background; label: the name tag anchor; route: the energy road from the core platform to the district along the painted roads (empty when none). core: the platform's centre, its radius and the area drones fly in (rx, ry). wave: the token wave display's rect.
